notes: Both marginal notes were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).

*for this* is taken as the whole rendering of `הִיא` under rule 33, the supplied preposition stating what the recast nominal contributes; the competing reading gives only *this* to the pronoun and marks *for* added.

`כָּל־כִּשְׁרוֹן הַמַּעֲשֶׂה` → *every skilful work*: `כֹּל` is itself what the quantifying determiner *every* renders, so the article on the rectum is unrepresented (rules 15, 41), and the construct is rendered attributively under rule 28.
